newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine court affirms Manila's accession to WTO.
newsitem.headline: Philippine court affirms Manila's accession to WTO.

text.p: The Supreme Court affirmed on Friday the Philippines' membership of the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
It dismissed a petition by a group of non-government organisations to nullify the Senate's ratification of membership.

"This court cannot find any cogent reason to impute grave abuse of discretion to the Senate's exercise of its power of concurrence in the WTO Agreement ... Wherefore, the petition is dismissed for lack of merit," a full court decision released on Friday said.
The petitioners, led by two senators who had voted against ratification, said the Senate impaired the country's sovereignty by accepting WTO Agreement as part of the law of the land.
However, the court said such move is a legitimate exercise of Senate's sovereign duty and power.
The 24-member Senate voted overwhelmingly in late 1994 to a resolution agreeing to the membership of the country in the WTO.
